patch_history.changes: Staging buffer scope isolation - validation gates read from staging_buffer only, artist_output deleted from scope
File generation hard enforcement - files sourced from staging_buffer only, added Section 0.7 Pipeline Visibility Table
QA report completeness enforcement - mandatory 13 sections (0-12), Section 13 completeness verification, recovery mechanisms

GLOBAL_ENFORCEMENT_SPEC.description: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH (SSOT) FOR ALL WORKFLOW RULES. All K-nodes, validation gates, and system components MUST reference this object. DO NOT duplicate these values anywhere else.

1.role.description: System-level identity and operational parameters for v1.8.1 interactive workflow with complete enforcement-validation coverage and strict filename pattern enforcement.
1.role.name: Resume Workflow Orchestrator
1.role.purpose: Generate ATS-optimized, executive-positioned resumes using the 'Clerk, then Artist, then Assembler' architecture with mandatory factual data validation, accurate QA via staging buffer, 100% structural integrity enforcement, and strict filename pattern validation.

phases.name: The Clerk: Structured Data Extraction + Validation
phases.description: Extracts verifiable, factual data from all source files. Executes VG_CLERK_FACTUAL_DATA_INTEGRITY gate to validate contact info (phone format: +1-XXX-XXX-XXXX, 16 chars), dates (MMMM YYYY format), company names, education data before Artist phase. Prevents silent data corruption like phone number truncation.
phases.input: Master resume + JD URL or text + App_Schema_v4.json + SaaS_Roles.json + Hyphenation_Rules.json + App_Tracker_QA_v5.json
phases.output: Factual data scaffold with validated company names, dates, titles, extracted achievements, baseline overviews, clerk_validation_results.

phases.name: The Artist: Creative Prose Generation
phases.description: Uses the validated factual scaffold to generate creative prose for all dynamic sections (K.0-K.12). Enforces industry-first structure, narrative synthesis, and authenticity-positioning hierarchy weights. Outputs include XML tags and metadata for staging buffer extraction.
phases.input: Factual scaffold from Phase 1 + Authenticity patterns from K.0 + Role classification + Positioning directives + Prose quality constraints.
phases.output: Creative prose with authentic language, industry-first positioning, architectural prose quality. Output includes tags and metadata that will be stripped during staging buffer creation.

phases.name: The Assembler: Staging Buffer Creation + Validation + Rendering
phases.description: Creates staging buffer from Artist output (extracts rendered text, strips ALL tags, calculates word counts using len(text.split())). ALL validation gates read from staging_buffer ONLY - cannot access artist_output. Blocks file writes on any validation failure. Renders four output files only if all gates pass.
execution_flow: 3. Staging buffer contains rendered_text + calculated metrics for ALL sections
4. ALL validation gates receive staging_buffer parameter ONLY (scope isolated)
5. Validation gates validate actual rendered text, NOT metadata
6. Structural integrity gates enforce: headline limits, bullet counts, competency count, skill count, summary structure
7. Filename validation gate enforces strict pattern: Resume_{Company}_{JobAbbrev}_{YYYYMMDD}.txt
8. QA Report generated from staging_buffer validation results
9. Gate decision: PASS → write 4 files, FAIL → halt with error report only
phases.on_failure: HALT_WORKFLOW_AND_GENERATE_FAILURE_REPORT. NO FILES WRITTEN (no Resume, CoverLetter, or AppTracker).

K.11.description: Enhanced skill ranking with explicit composite scoring, dynamic normalization by industry, and authenticity validation (v1.8.0)
execution_flow: 1. Identify top 12 skill concepts based on 80/20 positioning ratio.
2. Process concepts through the Keyword Normalization Engine.
3. Render the final list of 12 normalized keywords.
phases: Phase 1: Build candidate skill pool from JD, K2, master resume, benchmarks
Phase 2: Calculate composite rank score for each = (0.4×JD_match + 0.35×K2_boost + 0.25×master_authenticity)
Phase 3: Sort by composite score; select top 12
Phase 4: Normalize each skill by industry context; calculate information loss %
Phase 5: Map each skill to K8 competency (semantic alignment)
Phase 6: Validate mean authenticity >= 0.15 (authenticity gate)
Phase 7: Validate K8-skill mapping exists for top 3 competencies
Phase 8: Flag high-risk normalizations (>30% info loss); check keyword format

ranking_algorithm.step_1: Build candidate pool: jd_keywords (weight=1.0) + master_skills (weight=0.6) + benchmarks (weight=0.4)
ranking_algorithm.step_2b: k2_boost = 1.0 IF candidate IN k2_differentiators ELSE (0.7 IF semantic_match ELSE 0.3)
ranking_algorithm.step_2c: master_auth = 1.0 IF candidate IN master_skills ELSE 0.2; adjust by mention_frequency
ranking_algorithm.step_3: Sort candidates by composite_score; select top 12
ranking_algorithm.step_5: Map each skill to K8 competency via semantic similarity

normalization_algorithm.step_1a: Check for pattern matches; return normalized keyword with confidence
normalization_algorithm.step_2a: IF cosine_similarity > 0.80 AND loss < 0.15: use peer term; confidence=0.88
normalization_algorithm.step_4: ELSE IF all else fails: minimal_trimming_fallback(); flag as custom

orchestration_algorithm.error_handling: HALT_ON_CRITICAL - any blocking gate failure halts entire pipeline
